nodes.description: Mapping of reflection (r) balances for every account, core accounting of the reflection token model.
Mapping of true token balances used for excluded accounts that hold real token amounts instead of reflections.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount of ERC20 allowances checked in transferFrom.
Mapping marking accounts that are exempt from tax and team fees during transfers.
Mapping marking accounts excluded from the reflection mechanism (they use _tOwned).
Dynamic array holding all accounts excluded from reflections, iterated in _getCurrentSupply.
Total true token supply (1000000000000 * 10**9).
Total reflections supply, MAX - (MAX % _tTotal); reduced by fees in _reflectFee.
Current tax fee percentage applied on transfers, settable by owner via _setTaxFee.
Current team/marketing fee percentage applied on transfers, settable by owner via _setTeamFee.
Maximum amount allowed per transfer for non-owner accounts.
Payable address receiving half of the swapped ETH, target of a low-level transfer.
Payable address receiving the other half of the swapped ETH, target of a low-level transfer.
Immutable Uniswap V2 router interface used to swap tokens for ETH.
Immutable Uniswap V2 pair address created in the constructor for this token.
Boolean flag controlling whether automatic token-to-ETH swapping is active.
Reentrancy guard flag set by the lockTheSwap modifier around swaps.
Timestamp until which ownership is locked; compared against now in unlock.
Current owner address used by the onlyOwner access control modifier.
Stored previous owner used to reclaim ownership in unlock.
Public ERC20 transfer entry point that forwards to _transfer with _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transferFrom entry point calling _transfer and then _approve after the external state update.
Public ERC20 approve entry point writing _allowances through _approve.
Core private transfer routine: validates, enforces maxTxAmount, triggers swap + ETH send, then calls _tokenTransfer.
Private lockTheSwap function that approves the router and swaps token balance for ETH.
Private function splitting the contract ETH balance between team and marketing wallets via transfer.
Dispatcher that removes fees if needed and routes to the excluded/non-excluded transfer variants.
Standard reflection transfer for two non-excluded accounts.
Credits the team fee in reflections to the contract address.
Reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee and accumulates _tFeeTotal.
Computes t and r amounts, fees and team amounts used by all transfer variants.
Public function burning sender reflections and accounting them as fees in _tFeeTotal.
Public function restoring _previousOwner; depends on msg.sender and block timestamp comparison.
Owner-only function renouncing ownership temporarily and setting _lockTime using now + time.
Owner-only function manually swapping the whole contract token balance for ETH.
Owner-only function manually sending the contract ETH balance to the team wallets.
Owner-only setter toggling the swapEnabled automatic swap flag.
Owner-only function adding an account to the reflection exclusion list.
Owner-only function removing an account from the reflection exclusion list.
Owner-only function permanently setting _owner to the zero address.
Owner-only function assigning a new owner address.
Owner-only setter for _maxTxAmount with a lower bound requirement.
Owner-only setter for _taxFee bounded between 1 and 25.
Owner-only setter for _teamFee bounded between 1 and 25.
Transfer variant from a non-excluded sender to an excluded recipient, updating both _rOwned and _tOwned.
Transfer variant from an excluded sender to a non-excluded recipient, updating both _tOwned and _rOwned.
Transfer variant for excluded sender and excluded recipient updating both true balances.
Pure helper computing true fee, team fee and transfer amount from tAmount.
Pure helper computing reflection amount, reflection fee and reflection transfer amount.
Computes the current reflection rate rSupply/tSupply used across the accounting.
Iterates the _excluded array to derive effective rSupply and tSupply.
Caller-controlled address used as transfer sender, allowance owner and unlock permission check.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as the Uniswap swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
Low-level ETH transfer to _teamWalletAddress in sendETHToTeam, forwards value to an external address.
Low-level ETH transfer to _marketingWalletAddress in sendETHToTeam, forwards value to an external address.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens executed before transfer state updates.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.

edges.reason: transfer forwards the call to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom invokes _transfer before updating the allowance.
_transfer invokes _tokenTransfer to perform the actual accounting.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth, an external interaction, before the sender/recipient balances are updated.
_transfer calls sendETHToTeam which pushes ETH out before token state changes are applied.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferToExcluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferFromExcluded.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferBothExcluded.
_transferStandard relies on _getValues for fee arithmetic rounding and rate division.
_transferStandard credits the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the reflection fee via _reflectFee.
_transferToExcluded uses _getValues for fee and rate arithmetic.
_transferFromExcluded uses _getValues for fee and rate arithmetic.
_transferBothExcluded uses _getValues for fee and rate arithmetic.
_getValues calls _getTValues which multiplies and divides to derive fees.
_getValues calls _getRValues which multiplies amounts by the current rate.
_getValues calls _getRate which divides rSupply by tSupply.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply which subtracts excluded balances from totals.
_takeTeam calls _getRate, exposing it to precision loss in the rate division.
manualSwap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualSend calls sendETHToTeam with the full contract ETH balance.
swapTokensForEth performs an external call into the Uniswap router, transferring control outside the contract.
sendETHToTeam pushes ETH to _teamWalletAddress, an external value transfer.
sendETHToTeam pushes ETH to _marketingWalletAddress, an external value transfer.
The router swap callback path returns control to _transfer before _tokenTransfer updates balances, enabling reentrancy through a malicious pair/token.
ETH sent to the team wallet can execute recipient fallback logic before sendETHToTeam returns.
transfer derives the sender from the untrusted msg.sender via _msgSender.
transferFrom uses the untrusted msg.sender as spender for the allowance update.
unlock compares the untrusted msg.sender against _previousOwner for permission.
swapTokensForEth passes the miner-influenced block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
_transferStandard subtracts from and adds to the _rOwned reflection balances.
_takeTeam adds the team reflections to _rOwned of the contract.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
deliver subtracts the reflection amount from _rOwned of the sender.
deliver reduces _rTotal by the burned reflection amount.
lock writes _lockTime using now + time, a timestamp dependent state write.
lock sets _owner to the zero address, a privileged ownership state change.
unlock reads _lockTime and compares it with the current timestamp.
unlock restores ownership by assigning _owner from _previousOwner.
unlock reads _previousOwner to validate the caller.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with the supplied address.
excludeAccount sets _isExcluded[account] to true, a privileged flag change.
excludeAccount pushes the account into the _excluded array.
includeAccount clears _isExcluded[account].
includeAccount mutates and pops the _excluded array.
setSwapEnabled writes the swapEnabled flag that governs automatic swaps.
_setMaxTxAmount writes the _maxTxAmount transfer limit.
_setTaxFee writes _taxFee, changing the fee taken on every transfer.
_setTeamFee writes _teamFee, changing the fee diverted to the team.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to validate non-owner transfers.
_transfer reads swapEnabled to decide whether to swap.
_transfer reads and relies on the inSwap guard flag around the external swap.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether to take fees.
_tokenTransfer reads _isExcluded for sender and recipient to pick the transfer variant.
swapTokensForEth uses the uniswapV2Router state variable for the external call.
sendETHToTeam reads _teamWalletAddress as the ETH recipient.
sendETHToTeam reads _marketingWalletAddress as the ETH recipient.
_getValues reads _taxFee to compute the fee amounts.
_getValues reads _teamFee to compute the team amounts.
_getCurrentSupply starts from _rTotal and subtracts excluded reflection balances.
_getCurrentSupply starts from _tTotal and subtracts excluded true balances.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rOwned of each excluded account when recomputing supply.
Recipient parameter of transfer flows into the internal _transfer routine.
Amount parameter of transfer flows into the internal _transfer routine.
Sender parameter is consumed by _transfer for validation and balance updates.
Sender parameter is forwarded from _transfer into _tokenTransfer.
tAmount parameter is used by deliver in the reflection subtraction.
time parameter is added to now to set _lockTime in lock.
newOwner parameter becomes the new _owner value.
maxTxAmount parameter is validated and written to _maxTxAmount.
taxFee parameter is validated and written to _taxFee.
teamFee parameter is validated and written to _teamFee.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped in swapTokensForEth.
Local path array is passed to the router swap in swapTokensForEth.
amount parameter is halved and transferred to both wallets in sendETHToTeam.
Local contractTokenBalance governs the swap decision inside _transfer.
Local contractETHBalance is read in _transfer before calling sendETHToTeam.
takeFee parameter selects whether fees are removed in _tokenTransfer.
tTeam parameter is converted to reflections and credited in _takeTeam.
rFee parameter is subtracted from _rTotal in _reflectFee.
tFee parameter is added to _tFeeTotal in _reflectFee.
currentRate parameter is the divisor used in the rate computation.
account parameter is excluded from reflections in excludeAccount.
enabled parameter is written to the swapEnabled flag.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only exists to feed the public transfer entry point.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the public transfer entry point.
The sender parameter is the local alias of msg.sender inside the core _transfer routine.
tAmount is the only input of the core deliver accounting function.
The time parameter exists solely to compute _lockTime inside lock.
newOwner is the only input used to update the privileged _owner state.
maxTxAmount is the only input written to the _maxTxAmount limit.
taxFee is the only input written to the _taxFee state variable.
teamFee is the only input written to the _teamFee state variable.
tokenAmount is the value approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth.
The path local is constructed and consumed entirely within swapTokensForEth.
The amount parameter is halved and pushed out by sendETHToTeam.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary computed inside _transfer to size the swap.
contractETHBalance is a temporary read inside _transfer to size the ETH send.
takeFee is the boolean switch consumed by _tokenTransfer to remove fees.
tTeam is the sole input converted to reflections in _takeTeam.
rFee is a direct input of the _reflectFee state update.
tFee is a direct input of the _reflectFee state update.
currentRate is the local result of the _getRate division computation.
The account parameter is the target written into the exclusion state by excludeAccount.
enabled is the only input written to the swapEnabled flag.
